title: A sodium–urea interaction does not reliably improve spot urine osmolality prediction across independent NHANES samples
abstract: In 4,631 held-cycle NHANES adults, adding one prespecified serum sodium-by-log(BUN) interaction to nonlinear blood chemistry and demographic predictors reduced survey-weighted urine-osmolality MSE by 26.71 (mOsm/kg)² (95% paired source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -234.40 to 243.09); the interval crosses zero and a cubic baseline reverses the gain. No reliable incremental marker was established.
